# Bump the engine to 13.4.0 and drop the released 13.3.1 note

## Context

`publish.mjs prepare` can only run once `package.json` reads 13.4.0 on `dev`, and the cut record #20655 needs that before its second step. The 13.4 notes merged in #20583 without the bump; the 13.3.1 cut-prep (#20024) had carried both. So the bump is its own one-PR leaf.

## The Problem

`prepare`'s preflight reads the release version from `package.json`, which is 13.3.1 at `dev` 1ce382ae1c, and it refuses a checkout that has not been bumped. Bumping alone turns CI red. `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/release/PublishReleaseNoteOrphan.spec.mjs` requires every note in `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/` to sit at or above `package.json`'s version. `v13.3.1.md`, which the 13.3.1 release kept as its archive, would then sit below it. Dropping the note in turn breaks the committed release index. `apps/portal/resources/data/releases.json` lists only 13.3.1 at `v13.3.1.md`, so the Portal's news route on `dev` would fetch a 404 page as markdown. CI caught this on the first head: `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` failed on the Markdown component's 404 warning. Locally it is 3/3 red, and 3/3 green with only the note restored. The 13.3.0 and 13.3.1 cuts had the same window, but no spec covered news routes until #20599.

## The Architectural Reality

- `package.json`'s `version` and two lines of `package-lock.json` (3, the root, and 9, `packages[""]`) read 13.3.1.
- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/` holds `v13.3.1.md` and `v13.4.0.md`. No file in the repository links to `v13.3.1.md`. The 13.3.1 note lives on in its GitHub release and the Portal's archive.
- `prepare` would drop `v13.3.1.md` itself, but only in the release commit, after this PR's CI has already run.

## The Fix

The bump and the drop in one commit; the index follows them:
- `package.json` 13.3.1 → 13.4.0, the only line changed;
- the lock's two root fields to 13.4.0;
- `git rm .github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.3.1.md`;
- `node buildScripts/docs/index/release.mjs -r .github/RELEASE_NOTES`, the generator `prepare.mjs` runs in the release commit, so the index lists the one note on disk. Its date falls back to the file's birthtime until `prepare` stamps the note.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (the root and `packages[""]`) read 13.4.0, and `apps/portal/resources/data/releases.json` indexes `v13.4.0.md`; no other line changes.
- [ ] AC-2: `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.4.0.md` is the only note.
- [ ] AC-3: These pass locally, and CI is green:
  - the release specs (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/release/`), `prepare.spec.mjs` and `checkPackageContents.spec.mjs`;
  - `npm run check-relative-links` and `npm run check-package-contents`;
  - the Portal e2e folder (`test/playwright/e2e/portal/`).
- [ ] AC-4: A cross-family review, and the operator merges.

## Out of Scope

The release commit and the release PR (the release leaf under #20655), and the note's text.
